target: Case editor state resilience across every section
transitions: NullFlavor -> cleared or original value -> save -> reload
live repeatable row -> UI delete -> save -> absent from live list
delete one row -> preserve sibling identity and values

adaptiveMutations.trigger: UI exposes a value that the frontend contract rejects
adaptiveMutations.evolution: compare rendered options, frontend generated allowed set, backend acceptance, and persisted readback independently

adaptiveMutations.trigger: authority route fails before the form renders
adaptiveMutations.evolution: derive the UI route token separately from API validation authorities and fail before mutation on unknown routes

adaptiveMutations.trigger: repeatable create collides with an existing sequence
adaptiveMutations.evolution: read the live collection and allocate an explicit unused sequence before creating verification rows

adaptiveMutations.trigger: a run stops after a committed mutation
adaptiveMutations.evolution: perform bounded recovery, verify the original state, and retain both failure and recovery evidence

adaptiveMutations.trigger: a UI save is blocked before an HTTP write
adaptiveMutations.evolution: classify it separately from server rejection and require captured UI error text plus zero mutation requests

adaptiveMutations.trigger: navigation begins while the previous document is still complete
adaptiveMutations.evolution: require the expected URL and the destination section shell together before locating controls

coveragePolicy.singletonSection: direct save, NullFlavor when a rendered control exists, reload, relogin, database and audit
coveragePolicy.repeatableSection: create owned target and sibling, direct save, NullFlavor when supported, UI delete target, sibling preservation, reload, relogin, database and audit
coveragePolicy.completion: do not count a section unless every applicable transition has a terminal oracle
